title: AI infrastructure company Cornelis raises $205M to chip away at Nvidia's dominance | TechCrunch
summary: Though Nvidia chips can technically run on other networking fabrics, they’re optimized to run on Nvidia’s own software, making it much easier — and more enticing — for customers to use Nvidia’s full GPU stack.
